results.method: Independent reproduction: cache file read directly as JSONL; near-duplicate components and the stratified greedy 60/20/20 partition re-derived from scratch; all 19,683 rows re-scored with a fresh detector at its native operating point; Wilson/AUROC (pairwise cross-checked against the rank walk)/AUPRC/TPR@FPR and row + cluster bootstrap CIs recomputed with independent implementations, replicating the documented single-shared-rng order (seed 20261116). No tuning on the final holdout.

drops.item: Worker B fit/validation partitions (scored, but headline is final-test)
drops.reason: pooled metrics are reproduced; the headline comparison is the final-test holdout, which influenced no decision

notes: Independent reproduction of Worker B's Beemo full-split evaluation. Every compared field either agrees exactly or is listed in 'discrepancies'. Verdict AGREE_WITH_FINDINGS means all numbers reproduce exactly and the only failed checks are the documented findings listed in 'findings' (possibly empty). The final-test headline is a negative result (AUROC 0.4027, below chance; AUPRC 0.7331 below the 0.7778 prevalence baseline; native TPR 0/3059, FPR 0/874) reported as measured, not tuned around. History: the first reproduction run targeted the 4881e15 artifact and found two provenance findings (stale manifest SHA references after the manifests were re-frozen, and all 311 near-duplicate pairs mislabelled 'cross-prompt' although every pair is within one prompt's 9 variants); Worker B has since regenerated the artifact at 895577c with corrected labels and current manifest references, and this reproduction targets the regenerated artifact.
